BiblicalUsage: Ben-Zocheth means "son of Zoheth." He was one of the tribe of Judah. You will find it in 1 Chronicles 4:20.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Ben-Zocheth is in Scripture for a reason, and no name there is an accident.
